agent_data_note: Use mounted DFA-GNN artifact at `dataset_candidate/dfagnns-issta2025/`. Primary CFGs are under `graphs/`; DFAGNNs code under `DFAGNNs/`; statement-count statistics under `statistics/`; programl_edited sources under `programl_edited/`.
benchmark_rules: Artifact is at `dataset_candidate/dfagnns-issta2025/` (workspace symlink; use for ls/read_file and $DFAGNNS_HOME).
Primary inputs: graphs/*.ProgramGraph.pb (ProGraML CFGs), statistics/poj104_Statistics/poj104_full_statistics.json, DFAGNNs/clrs/_src/dfa/ (model + training scripts).
Train on POJ-104 programs with at most 50 CFG nodes; evaluate generalization on larger POJ-104 bins as stated in the task.

Ground-truth DFA states / trajectories must come from classical iterative DFA (programl.yzd_analyze after building programl_edited, or an equivalent classical analyzer). Do not use ground-truth states as model inputs at inference.
Forbidden: fabricating last-step / mean-step F1 numbers that were not measured.
Follow the paper evaluation protocol (trajectory supervision ablations, truncated trajectories, sample efficiency) as stated in the task.
non_goals: Using a handful of hand-written toy CFGs as the sole evaluation evidence
Fabricating generalization-to-large-graph results that were not executed
Treating ProGraML final labels as a substitute for implementing DFA-aligned GNN variants
